$comment: ARC-03: tables in module schemas without household_id (no customer data), each with the reason. Checked by scripts/check-schema.ts; a customer-data table never goes here.

tables.audit.platform_entries: Platform audit log (П-10): changes that belong to no household — feature flags and kill switches (CICD-06), staff actions later. Opaque staff ids and setting values; no customer data.
tables.feature_flags.flags: Rollout state of each feature flag (CICD-06): platform-wide setting (stage, share in %), no customer data. Test spaces are in feature_flags.test_households under the household policy.
tables.feature_flags.kill_switches: Kill switch of each module (CICD-06 FR 3): platform-wide setting (module name, on/off), no customer data.
